directives.topic: Friday September Jobs Report: Scenario Analysis and TBT/TMV Positioning
directives.why: The September jobs report (Friday October 2) is now the single most important near-term macro catalyst. Consensus is +90-100K but JOLTS and consumer confidence signal downside risk. Need a scenario matrix: (1) >140K → October hike back to 50%+, TBT/TMV positioning; (2) 90-120K → status quo, December lock; (3) <80K → October dead, what happens to bond yields and growth stocks? Also: does a weak jobs number actually help META/AMD via multiple expansion, or does it signal recession risk that hurts ad spending?

directives.topic: AMD Venice CPU: Deep Dive on 2027 Booking Status and Competitive Moat
directives.why: Research team flagged AMD Venice demand as 'off the charts' with 2027 fully booked and 2028 booking underway. This is potentially the most actionable near-term signal in the portfolio — AMD is currently only 7.4% of portfolio, below its deserved weight if this thesis is real. Need: (1) What customers are booking Venice? Is Meta the anchor or is there broad hyperscaler demand? (2) Venice competitive spec vs. Nvidia's inference-optimized chips (GB200 NVL72)? (3) AMD analyst estimates for CPU inference revenue contribution in 2027-2028 — has the street modeled this?

directives.topic: META October 28 Earnings Preparation: Muse Conversion Model and CapEx Scenario Matrix
directives.why: October 28 is 28 days away and META is ~53% of the portfolio. Need a complete earnings scenario matrix: (1) Bull case: revenue $63-64B upper half of guide + Muse paid conversion >5% of 3.4M downloads disclosed + CapEx guidance maintained → stock to $810+; (2) Base case: revenue $62B midguide + Muse qualitative commentary + CapEx in range → stock $750-780; (3) Bear case: revenue $61B floor + Muse conversion not disclosed or disappointing + CapEx raised further → stock $680-720. Also: what are the specific Muse metrics to watch — is there any chance Meta pre-announces a subscription milestone before Oct 28?

directives.topic: OpenAI 'o' Agent DevDay: Real Threat to Muse or Noise?
directives.why: OpenAI's Monday DevDay reveal caused a 4.2% single-session selloff in META. Need a clear-eyed competitive analysis: (1) What exactly is the 'o' agent product — task automation, always-on, or different paradigm? (2) OpenAI's distribution (ChatGPT users) vs. META's distribution (3.4B users on WhatsApp/Instagram/Facebook) — how do they compare for agentic AI? (3) Has the market correctly repriced the competitive risk, or is the selloff an overreaction to a product that won't ship at scale for 12+ months? This directly informs whether to hold META into Oct 28 at current sizing.

directives.topic: TBT vs TMV: Sizing Upgrade Decision for December Hike Certainty
directives.why: December hike is now priced at 100% certainty. TBT (2x inverse 20+ Year Treasury) is the current position. TMV (3x inverse 20+ Year Treasury) offers more leverage but also more decay and volatility. With December at 100%, should I be in TMV for the final push? Key questions: (1) What is the expected TBT vs TMV performance if 10Y moves from 5.30% to 5.60% by December? (2) What is the daily decay differential between TBT and TMV on flat yield days? (3) Is 10 weeks until December 9 the right holding period for a leveraged inverse ETF, or does decay erode the thesis?
